title: @objectstack/lint: export the dataset dimension leg's group-key classifier, so a consumer does not recompose the door's predicates
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`) from the cloud dev report objectstack-ai/cloud#2862 `6143445321` (out-of-scope finding 3). This is an enhancement, not a defect.

## What

`packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts`'s dimension leg (`dimension-json-stored-field-refused`, #20890) decides whether a field can be a group key with `groupKeyClassOf`, which applies the analytics door's two spec predicates in the door's order: `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES`, then `isMultiValueField`. `groupKeyClassOf` is not exported.

## Why it matters

Cloud's AI build derives dataset dimensions and must only derive group keys the door serves. Without the export, cloud's `dataset-derive.ts` `isDimensionField` composes the same two spec predicates in the same order itself. It copies no list, but it is a second account of the door's ordering, so it drifts if the leg ever gains a third predicate. An export would make it one call to the framework's own verdict, which is the "no private re-implementation" stance the lint's other exports already take.

## Priority

`priority:p3`: cloud works today, and it does not block cloud's v18 upgrade (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709).
